_about: Public-domain Dirk Philips (Dietrich Philip, 1504-1568), Menno Simons's colleague and the Anabaptist movement's systematic theologian, for the Word Hoard: his Enchiridion, or Hand Book of the Christian Doctrine and Religion, translated from the German and compared with the Dutch by A. B. Kolb (Elkhart, Ind.: Mennonite Publishing Co., 1910), from an Internet Archive scan. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 40 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
